highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 previews the v4 line with Skia m147, variable fonts, and animated WebP encoding.
highlights_body: The preview series also adds sampling control for surface draws and zero-copy stream-to-data conversion, broadens native platform support, and fixes a finalizer crash. It includes a breaking Vulkan API rename; review the migration note before testing an upgrade.

breaking.title: Vulkan YCbCr conversion info has a new type name
breaking.body: `GRVkImageInfo.YcbcrConversionInfo` now uses `GRVkYcbcrConversionInfo` instead of `GrVkYcbcrConversionInfo`. Update references and equality comparisons when rebuilding Vulkan code, because the former type's value-equality interface and operators are removed.

bullets.detail: The v4 preview line moves the bundled renderer through Skia milestones m132, m133, and m147.
Variable fonts flow through SkiaSharp and HarfBuzzSharp, while color font palette selection and variable-font handling are improved.
New surface-draw overloads accept `SKSamplingOptions`, allowing callers to choose filter and mipmap behavior.

bullets.lead: Animated WebP and stream data conversion
bullets.detail: `SKWebpEncoder` can encode frame sequences as animated WebP, and `SKStream.GetData()` converts seekable streams to `SKData` without an intermediate byte array.
HarfBuzzSharp adds the `HBColor` representation and fills in missing wrappers with consistent naming.
A collection-order bug no longer crashes finalization when an `SKPathBuilder` is collected before an `SKPath` it created.

bullets.lead: MAUI Android tab switching restores SKGLView
bullets.detail: SKGLView is reattached after returning to a MAUI TabBar tab instead of remaining blank.

bullets.lead: Additional Linux and Tizen native assets
bullets.detail: Android-hosted Linux Bionic and Tizen x64 and arm64 are available as native targets.
Apple libraries align with current versioned TFMs, and WASM native assets now require .NET 8 or later.
The bundled libexpat, libpng, zlib, FreeType, and libjpeg-turbo dependencies have been updated.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Skia milestone and variable-font work, managed default-typeface resolution, the SKPath finalizer fix, and sample improvements
contributor_summaries.4Darmygeometry: Linux Bionic native assets and C# 13 support for legacy target frameworks
contributor_summaries.SimonvBez: The Android MAUI TabBar fix for SKGLView rendering

preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 opened the v4 line with the Skia m147 engine update, variable fonts, surface sampling options, and expanded Linux and Tizen support.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.2.1: Preview 2 added animated WebP encoding, zero-copy `SKStream.GetData()`, and the SKPath finalizer fix.
preview_summaries.v4.147.0-preview.3.1: Preview 3 added HBColor and HarfBuzz wrapper improvements, refreshed bundled dependencies, and updated WASM targeting.

harfbuzz_summary: Adds variable-font and color-palette support, the HBColor value type, and missing HarfBuzz wrappers.

v4.147.0-preview.1.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 Preview 1 opens the v4 line on Skia m147.
v4.147.0-preview.1.1.body: It adds variable fonts, surface sampling options, and expanded Linux and Tizen native support.

v4.147.0-preview.2.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 Preview 2 adds animated WebP encoding and stream-to-data conversion.
v4.147.0-preview.2.1.body: It also fixes the SKPath finalizer collection-order crash.

v4.147.0-preview.3.1.headline: SkiaSharp 4.147.0 Preview 3 completes the preview line with HarfBuzz and platform updates.
v4.147.0-preview.3.1.body: It adds HBColor, improves HarfBuzz wrappers, and updates WASM targeting.
